text: {"groups":[{"members":["c1","c2","c3","c4"],"primary":"c1","title":"Prohibition on the sale or use of coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents or manage occupancy levels (BMC Chapter 13.63)","requirement":"It is unlawful to sell, license or otherwise provide to Berkeley landlords any coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels for residential units in Berkeley, and it is unlawful for landlords to use one. Each unit and each month of use is a separate violation, enforceable by the City Attorney and by aggrieved tenants through private suits with prevailing-party attorney's fees.","key_value":"Ban on selling or using coordinated pricing algorithms; civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; Competitor Data = non-public data less than 90 days old","status":"in_force","effective_date":null,"end_date":null,"citation":"Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.63; Ordinance No. 7,992-N.S.","coverage_conditions":"All residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley; applies to landlords and to sellers or licensors of such algorithms to Berkeley landlords.","exemptions":"Excluded from the definition of coordinated pricing algorithm: (a) products or processes that publish aggregated, anonymous rental data without recommending rents, fees, occupancy rates or terms; (b) products used to set rent or income limits under local, state or federal affordable housing guidelines; (c) products or processes used for market research for project financing, appraisals, or research, testing or training for software development, provided Competitor Data is not an input when a recommendation is calculated for a Berkeley landlord.","coverage_from":"c1","conflict_note":null}],"dropped":[]}
